name: Michigan LARA BCC Electrical Contractor License Search

termsReviewNotes: Michigan.gov policies were reviewed. Source-specific redistribution approval for Accela license-search fields has not been confirmed.
updateFrequency: unknown; verify against the official BCC license lookup before relying on freshness
licenseTypesIncluded: Related electrician and specialty classifications exposed by the official BCC lookup
knownExclusions: This source is scoped to Michigan BCC electrical and related specialty credentials.
Detroit-issued credentials, local registrations, permits, inspections, utility approvals, and non-electrical contractor credentials may require separate official paths.
Future adapter work must distinguish contractor, master, journeyperson, apprentice, fire-alarm, and sign classifications.
rateLimitNotes: No automated path is implemented. Use the official lookup manually and do not bypass portal controls.
publicRecordsNotes: Official source metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that another credential, registration, permit, or authorization does not exist.
officialLookupReviewNotes: The BCC site links this Accela property/licensee search as Find / Verify a BCC Licensed Professional or Business.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No official stable bulk export was confirmed during this review.
researchNotes: Registry-only source for Michigan electrical, fire-alarm, and sign contractor credentials.
verificationCaveats: This source covers Michigan BCC electrical and related specialty credentials only.
No matching record means no match in the checked source at the checked time, not proof that another credential or authorization does not exist.
verificationNotes: No supported adapter is exposed while the Accela data contract, classification behavior, privacy fields, and reuse position remain unreviewed.
maintainerNotes: Preserve credential classification, source URL, checked time, caveats, raw record, and fingerprint in any future adapter.
